envelope.description: Scratch store module + unit tests (vscode-free, fake-fs drivable)

body.title: Scratch store module + unit tests (vscode-free, fake-fs drivable)
body.summary: New vscode-free store module vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-store.ts (ScratchFs interface + nodeScratchFs node default, createScratchStore/listScratches/createScratch/readScratch/deleteScratch) over plain .md files in the store root, mirroring attachment-store.ts's optional-fs + deps-injected pattern; plus fake-scratch-fs.ts and scratch-store.test.ts unit tests. link()-only atomic no-clobber publication, O_NOFOLLOW fd reads, ENOENT->[] and idempotent delete, ScratchRefused/ScratchNotFound/ScratchStoreError mapping. No daemon IPC.
acceptanceChecks: vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-store.ts + __tests__/fake-scratch-fs.ts are new files only (no edits to existing modules)
createScratchStore({root}) with fs omitted defaults to the node adapter; production wiring passes only { root, logger }

listScratches() returns ScratchEntry[] {id,name,mtime,size} sorted mtime desc (ties id asc), ENOENT readdir -> [], skips non-files/failed stats/non-.md, optional limit cap (menu uses 5; browse-all omits)
createScratch(title, body?) writes <yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md (slug: lowercase, spaces->dashes, non [a-z0-9-] dropped, all-symbol -> 'scratch'), collision ladder -2,-3 via lstat probes

publication is link(temp,new)+unlink(temp) ONLY (never rename): temp name has pid+random suffix and does not match *.md; EEXIST -> next suffix; post-link unlink failure is non-fatal and never returned as failure

readScratch validates id (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.md$, not '.'/'..', resolve strictly inside root) then open(O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW)+fstat regular file -> else ScratchRefused; ENOENT at open or fd-read -> ScratchNotFound; single fd is source of truth
deleteScratch validates via lstat regular file (symlinks refused -> ScratchRefused), unlink only (never recursive), ENOENT at lstat or unlink treated as success (idempotent)
error mapping: EACCES/ENOSPC/EROFS/not-a-dir -> ScratchStoreError; unit tests with fake fs prove refusal paths make ZERO fs mutation calls
unit suite scratch-store.test.ts passes incl. two-instance concurrent-create race over a real tmp dir proving exclusive publication

tests.name: scratch-store.test.ts: listScratches returns entries sorted by mtime desc with id/name/mtime/size (ENOENT->[], non-.md skipped, limit cap, ties id asc)

scratch-store.test.ts: createScratch writes <yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md via temp write + link()+unlink publication (never rename), collision ladder -2/-3, slug rules incl. all-symbol fallback 'scratch'; entry appears at list head
scratch-store.test.ts: refusal tests — ids '.', '..', traversal strings, symlinks and directories named *.md cause ScratchRefused with ZERO fs mutation calls recorded by fake-scratch-fs

scratch-store.test.ts: concurrent-create race with two independent store instances over the same real tmp dir — both racing creates succeed with distinct files, contents intact (link()+unlink exclusive publication, EEXIST suffix retry)
scratch-store.test.ts: ENOENT mapping — readdir ENOENT -> []; absence before lstat and disappearance between lstat and final read/unlink -> ScratchNotFound (read) / success (delete, idempotent)

scratch-store.test.ts: readScratch opens with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW + fstat single-fd regular-file check — symlink swapped in after validation yields ELOOP -> ScratchRefused; error mapping EACCES/ENOSPC/EROFS -> ScratchStoreError
